# DWS Jewellery

> Wholesale gemstone and sterling silver jewelry manufacturer based in Jaipur, India, specializing in turquoise, opal, and birthstone collections.

DWS Jewellery is a Jaipur-based wholesale supplier offering handcrafted sterling silver jewelry featuring premium gemstones including Arizona Turquoise, Larimar, Labradorite, and various opal varieties. The company serves retailers and wholesalers globally with both traditional Indian jewelry styles like Kundan and contemporary fashion collections.
